recentCommits.message:
feat: redesign sign-in flow and polish app-wide MVP issues

- Replace full-width social login buttons with icon tiles matching wallet
  grid size; add "get a wallet" popover with Eternl, Lace, Vespr links
- Two-column brand-navy layout on landing: branding left, sign-in right
- Thread darkLayout prop from LandingHero → AccessTokenOnboarding →
  RegistrationFlow so full-screen navy only applies on the landing page
- Extract SignInOptions as shared component; simplify ConnectWalletButton

Polish fixes:
- first-login-card: remove duplicate "Waiting for confirmation..." text
- connect-wallet-gate: fix capitalisation ("Sign-in failed", "Signing in...")
- app/(app)/error.tsx: replace raw h1/p with AndamioHeading/AndamioText
- credentials/page.tsx: remove rounded-full icon circle from summary card

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: add branded error and not-found pages

Add root-level 404 (brand-navy full-screen with ghosted number),
update in-app 404 and error boundaries to match app aesthetic,
and improve global-error fallback with inline brand styles.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(onboard): redesign access token onboarding flow

Remove icon circles from all card states, add overline step labels,
replace blockchain jargon with plain language, wrap inline loading
states in card containers, and rename "Mint Access Token" to
"Create Identity" throughout the registration flow.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: dark mode contrast and humanize copy

- Landing hero CTA buttons: bg-background -> bg-white (fixed) so they
  remain readable on bg-brand-navy in dark mode
- Step numerals: text-brand-navy/[0.08] -> text-foreground/[0.08] so
  the ghost color inverts correctly with the theme
- Value strip body text: pin to accent-foreground/70 for guaranteed
  contrast on bg-accent in dark mode
- Humanize landing copy: remove rule-of-three constructions, drop
  "Unlock opportunities" for "Prove your skills", tighten value props
- Humanize marketing.ts: fix negative parallelism and em dash in
  pioneers section, drop "start exploring" signposting
- Humanize branding.ts: remove -ing padding clause from longDescription
- Humanize README: remove "Specifically:", collapse triple negations,
  fix rule-of-three in Design Principles section

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: redesign landing page and fix wallet connection bugs

- Full landing-hero rewrite: left-aligned display hero on brand-navy,
  credential SVG, value strip (no cards), ghosted-numeral steps, navy CTA bookend
- AndamioHeading: add `display` size variant for hero headings
- globals.css: add --brand-navy token and map to Tailwind color
- Fix libsodium deduplication via npm overrides (wallet.signData was using
  uninitialised nested 0.7.10 copy of libsodium-wrappers-sumo)
- next.config.js: allow *.ftcdn.net image hostnames
- Design system compliance: AndamioText overline for dashboard section labels,
  AndamioButton replacing raw Button import in project page
- PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md: add impeccable skill context files

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
